meta.name: VHDL Entity
meta.description: A VHDL design synthesized to a gate netlist with GHDL and Yosys (desktop app); its pins come from the top entity's ports

vhdl.label: VHDL
vhdl.title: The VHDL text and its synthesis

generics.label: Generics
generics.title: Values for the entity's generics, e.g. W=8, N=2 (integers, true/false or enumeration names); empty = the defaults in the text

status.label: Netlist
status.title: What simulates: the netlist of the last synthesis

status.stale: The text changed since the last synthesis; the previous circuit still runs. Synthesize to update it.
status.staleMismatch: The ports changed since the last synthesis; outputs are X until it is synthesized again.
status.failed: The last synthesis failed ({{count}} errors); see the messages.
status.failedRunning: The last synthesis failed ({{count}} errors); the previous circuit still runs.
status.none: Not synthesized yet; outputs are X.
status.broken: The stored netlist cannot be used: {{message}}

editor.synthesizeTitle: Synthesize the text with GHDL and Yosys (Ctrl+Enter in the editor)
editor.loadTitle: Replace the text with a .vhd / .vhdl file
editor.loadFailed: The file could not be read.
editor.messagesOld: Messages of an earlier version of the text
editor.webNotice: VHDL synthesis uses GHDL in the desktop app. Here the stored netlist of the part simulates; it changes only when the part is synthesized on the desktop.
editor.preview: Ports read from the text: {{inputs}} inputs, {{outputs}} outputs
editor.previewError: Ports cannot be read from the text yet: {{message}}

hdlErrors.vhdlPortType: port type {{type}} is not supported (std_logic, std_ulogic, bit, boolean, their vectors, unsigned, signed)
hdlErrors.vhdlRange: the range of {{port}} cannot be worked out from the text (GHDL may still synthesize it)
hdlErrors.portWidth: port {{port}} is {{width}} bits in the netlist, {{declared}} declared
hdlErrors.verilogHeader: cannot read the port {{port}} written by GHDL

evo.unreadable: Logisim-evolution cannot read this entity ({{reason}}); it stops at an error dialog while opening the file

reason.duplicated: the text has more than one entity
reason.noEntity: it needs "entity <name> is … end <name>;" with the same name, in the same case, and without the word entity after end
reason.portDecl: a port declaration cannot be read
reason.portType: port {{port}}: it reads only std_logic and std_logic_vector(<number> downto <number>)
reason.portMode: port {{port}}: its mode must be in, out or inout

evo.ports: Logisim-evolution reads other pins from the text than this part has; the wires are placed by position, so they will not match
evo.generics: Logisim-evolution has no generics ({{names}}): it shows the entity with its default values
evo.genericsSet: the Generics setting "{{generics}}" is kept for this app only; Logisim-evolution does not use it
evo.notSynthesized: the part has no netlist; it opens here not synthesized
evo.simulation: Logisim-evolution simulates VHDL only through QuestaSim/ModelSim, and drops the stored netlist and generics when it saves the file
evo.importNoNetlist: the file has no netlist for this VHDL entity (e.g. saved by Logisim-evolution); synthesize it in the desktop app to simulate
evo.importNetlistBroken: the stored netlist of this VHDL entity cannot be read; synthesize it again
evo.importNetlistUnusable: the stored netlist of this VHDL entity cannot be used ({{message}}); synthesize it again
evo.importStale: the stored netlist of this VHDL entity is from an earlier version of its text; it runs until the part is synthesized again
evo.importNoPorts: the ports of this VHDL entity cannot be read from its text; it has no pins until the text is fixed
